def recursive_solve(n, sequence):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    pos = 0
    for i in range(1, 17):
        if sequence[i] > n:
            pos = i
            break
    costA = float('inf')
    costB = float('inf')
    costA = (n // sequence[pos - 1]) * (pos - 1) + recursive_solve(n % sequence[pos - 1], sequence)
    if sequence[pos] - n < n:
        costB = pos + recursive_solve(sequence[pos] - n, sequence)
    return min(costA, costB)
